verdict.text: Give it the input, get the result — and the results feed each other: minutes feed the board, one data source feeds every analysis, one dictionary governs every external word.
Progress already flows in from colleagues' meetings, chats and the project tracker; bcc one AI mailbox and it joins any thread. The surface is still narrow.
Push it deeper into daily work, hand coordination tasks to AI one by one, and halve the base's own maintenance rules.

workflows.name: Decision → execution
workflows.input: A meeting recording; the transcript dropped into an inbox folder
workflows.ai: Turns it into standard meeting minutes
workflows.output: Filed by company / product / department / partner
workflows.built: Action items flow into the department work list and progress board. Some are handed straight to AI to execute and deliver, closing the loop from decision to result. Related knowledge pages update in step.
workflows.gist: Recording in → filed minutes and action items out

workflows.name: Department progress board
workflows.input: Meeting minutes · team chat · project tracker · Telegram · email · new material in the base
workflows.ai: Updates the department work list every week, flagging on-time, off-track and stalled items
workflows.output: Progress board + stalled-items list + @-mentioned to-dos in the team chat
workflows.built: Department reports come straight from here. I can see anyone's progress at any time, nobody writes a weekly report anymore, and performance reviews use it as evidence.
workflows.gist: Six sources in → a weekly board of on-time, off-track and stalled

workflows.name: Partner tracking
workflows.ai: Daily briefs; weekly digests distilled into knowledge cards; colleagues' confirmations and corrections collected every two hours
workflows.output: One page per partner: key facts + progress
workflows.built: Fees, settlement terms and integration details are always at hand. Any later message to that partner can be drafted by AI from that one page.
workflows.gist: 15 partner chats in → one living page per partner

workflows.name: Product analytics
workflows.input: Event tracking · backend reports · push-notification log · swap transaction records
workflows.ai: Every night, reads user behaviour alongside that day's pushes, releases and market moves
workflows.built: Catches product bugs on its own (a feature nobody uses overnight, an error spike), measures every push, explains why swaps rose or fell and which chain is lagging.
workflows.gist: Nightly read of behaviour, pushes, releases and markets

workflows.name: Competitor research
workflows.ai: Installs the competitor's app by itself, walks every screen, takes screenshots, checks official figures, scores on a fixed five-dimension framework
workflows.built: Regulatory impact analysis, new-business option selection, vendor evaluation.
workflows.gist: A brand name in → a scored, comparable report out

workflows.name: External materials
workflows.input: Copy to publish · slide decks · statements · investor materials · patent documents
workflows.ai: Drafts to the terminology dictionary and brand rules; numbers and product specs come from one source only
workflows.output: English copy · report decks · customs declarations · patent responses and technical disclosures
workflows.built: One company-wide voice. A script catches wrong wording. Patent materials go straight to the attorney.
workflows.gist: One dictionary, one data source, every external document

workflows.name: Reputation & security
workflows.input: User reviews · media coverage · suspected impersonation
workflows.ai: Scans the web before dawn every day, scores and classifies
workflows.output: Daily sentiment report + archives of negatives and impersonators
workflows.built: AI produces the technical brief, the public response and the support scripts.
workflows.gist: Web scanned daily; incident kit ready when needed

workflows.name: Financial modelling
workflows.input: Accounts · authoritative shipment and revenue data · ops-meeting conclusions
workflows.ai: Builds the model, reconciles definitions, re-tunes after each meeting
workflows.output: Revenue forecast · five-year model · review summaries
workflows.built: Company-level analysis: reviews, forecasts, target-setting, and the numbers in investor materials.
workflows.gist: Model, reconcile, re-tune after every meeting

workflows.name: Support automation
workflows.ai: Understands the issue, drafts a reply, files every ticket as structured data
workflows.output: Sent after human sign-off · ticket archive
workflows.built: The archive supports any statistical cut and surfaces systemic problems automatically.
workflows.gist: Tickets read, replies drafted, archive built — a human sends

workflows.name: Self-maintenance
workflows.ai: Backs up core rules daily, runs a full health check monthly, and after any rule change checks whether existing content still complies
workflows.built: AI proposes. It never deletes. It never decides for me.
workflows.gist: Daily backup, monthly health check, rule-change audits

principles.k: Give it the input, get the result.
principles.v: A workflow counts only when a colleague can trigger it without me in the loop.

principles.k: AI proposes. I decide. Nothing gets deleted.
principles.v: Every change to the base is a suggestion until a person signs it off; deletion is never automated.

principles.k: Every number has one source and a stated definition.
principles.v: Revenue alone has three definitions. Mixing them is the fastest way to a wrong decision.

about.who: Fate leads product at a crypto wallet company serving consumers in North America and Europe. Since August 2026 the job has had a second half: building the knowledge base and AI platform that a product department can run on — and handing the department's coordination work to it, one piece at a time.
about.why_site: Most of this work is invisible from outside. This page makes it legible: what exists, how well it works, and what changed. It will grow to cover career background, writing and other channels.

footer.disclaimer: De-identified by design: no company, product or partner names appear here. Scores are self-assessed and re-run each quarter. Numbers reflect the stated data date.
